description: Find available travel data eSIM plans for a country, city, region, or ISO-2 destination such as 'Japan', 'Tokyo', 'Europe', or 'TR'. Filter by minimum validity (days), minimum data (data_gb), unlimited-only, maximum EUR budget and sort order; returns matching plans, price/validity details and a cheapest-match recommendation, without reserving stock. Use get_plan to validate a selected plan before prepare_order and list_destinations if a location is not recognized.

destination.description: Country, city, region or ISO-2 code.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).

unlimited.description: Only unlimited (true) or only fixed-data (false) plans.

name: search_plans
title: Search eSIM plans
